key_insight: PaddleMaterials unifies six materials-learning task classes in one toolkit, enabling verifiable cross-task workflows and compiler-accelerated execution.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can connect materials design, simulation and characterization models while tracking physical quantities, units and reference conventions.
method: Unify data processing, training, evaluation and pretrained-model management across six task classes.
Record scientific semantics in task interfaces to verify cross-task composition.
Switch to compiled execution through one setting, using graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted code generation.
evidence_signal: Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compilation accelerated every instance in eight groups; LiMnO2 formation-energy predictions differed from same-geometry PBE+U references by at most 7 meV/atom, with model-step costs below one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation.
watch_item: Reported accuracy and cost benefits are case-specific; broader transferability and hardware-dependent compilation gains require validation.
paper_title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
